/* DROP SCRIPT

DROP SECURITY POLICY [RLS_CI].[POL_CI]
DROP FUNCTION RLS_CI.AccessPredicate
DROP SCHEMA RLS_CI

*/




CREATE SCHEMA RLS_CI
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(@BankID varchar(20), @SourceSystemCode varchar(20))
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter ref_rls
WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
(
@BankID = BankID AND @SourceSystemCode = SourceSystemCode

)


CREATE SECURITY POLICY [RLS_CI].[POL_CI]
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Cards_Corporate],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Cards_Corporate_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Cards_Retail],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Cards_Retail_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Demographics_Corporate],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Demographics_Retail],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Deposit_Corporate],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Deposit_Corporate_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Deposits_Retail],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Deposits_Retail_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Loans_Corporate],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Loans_Corporate_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Loans_Retail],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,Source) ON [DW].[CI_Loans_Retail_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Treasury_Corporate],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Treasury_Corporate_En],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Treasury_Retail],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_CI.AccessPredicate(BankCode,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[CI_Treasury_Retail_En]
WITH (STATE = ON);
